text: Switch from OpenAI's API to Requesty by just changing the base URL — no SDK changes required
Fallback policies automatically retry requests on a different model if one fails, keeping the app reliable
quote: Fallback Policies automatically retry your requests with different models if one fails, ensuring your application stays reliable even when individual providers have issues.

text: On failure (timeout, rate limit, error), the router immediately retries the request against the next model in the chain
quote: Your request goes to the primary model first. If it fails (timeout, rate limit, error, etc.), the router immediately tries the next model in the chain.

text: Load balancing policies distribute requests across multiple models by user-defined weights
quote: Load Balancing Policies distribute your requests across multiple models based on weights you define. Perfect for A/B testing, gradual rollouts, and resource optimization.

text: Requests sharing the same trace_id or user_id are consistently routed to the same model
quote: Requests with the same trace_id or user_id always go to the same model.

text: Automatically caches long system prompts and repeated content to cut costs on providers that support prompt caching
quote: Requesty's auto caching automatically caches long system prompts and repeated content to reduce costs on any provider that supports prompt caching.

text: Supports bringing your own provider API keys (BYOK) for use through Requesty
quote: Bring Your Own Keys (BYOK) allows you to use your personal API keys from various providers with Requesty.

text: MCP Gateway lets AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, Roo Code) securely connect to MCP servers via Requesty's unified API
quote: The MCP (Model Context Protocol) Gateway enables AI coding assistants like Claude Code, Cursor, and Roo Code to securely connect to MCP servers through Requesty's unified API

text: Guardrails scan AI request content for sensitive information before it reaches the model provider
quote: Guardrails scan AI request content for sensitive information before it reaches a model provider.

text: Real-time analytics dashboard tracks costs, requests, tokens, cache savings, and latency across all models/providers
quote: Requesty's analytics dashboard gives you complete visibility into your AI usage across all models and providers. Track costs, requests, tokens, cache savings, and latency, all in real-time.

text: Traffic can be routed through EU (Frankfurt) infrastructure so all processing/storage stays in the EU
quote: Route your AI traffic through Requesty's EU infrastructure in Frankfurt, Germany (AWS eu-central-1). All processing and storage by Requesty stays in the EU.

text: Provides access to 300+ models to choose the best one per coding task
quote: Using the Requesty integration, you can: Use 300+ models while coding, giving you flexibility to choose the best model for each task.

text: Every supported model can output structured JSON, from simple json_object mode to strict schema-enforced json_schema mode
quote: Requesty makes every supported model speak structured JSON — from simple json_object mode to strict, schema-enforced json_schema mode.

text: Single API gives access to 600+ models with intelligent routing, real-time analytics, and centralized governance
quote: Access 600+ models through one API with intelligent routing, real-time analytics and centralized governance.
